thread:
violet: Heads-up: brief maintenance + resilience drill for ap-southeast on Mon 05/10 01:00-01:45 UTC. We'll run an elastic pool resize and a controlled regional failover to validate autoscaler behavior. Please ack if you're impacted. :bell:

omar: Ack. What's the expected customer impact?

violet: No expected customer impact; customer SLA unchanged. We'll enable internal SLO leniency and keep external alerts if an actual error occurs.

nora: Runbook link and preflight commands?

violet: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/eng-sre/ap-resize-failover. Preflight: check autoscaler metrics, replica health, and KV replication lag. Snippet:
```
redwood-admin autoscaler status --cluster ap-southeast
redwood-metrics query "kv_replication_lag{region=\"ap-southeast\"}"
```

oncall: I'll be oncall. If p95 latency >2x or errors >0.5% we pause and rollback. Who owns KV check?

omar: I'll own KV checks. I'll also place temporary alert mute for internal pagers for the window.

infra-bot: Calendar invite created and preflight job scheduled at 00:40 UTC. Job ID: preflight-195001

infra-bot: Preflight result: autoscaler healthy, kv lag 18ms, replicas healthy. Ready to proceed.

violet: Starting resize -> scale secondary pool to 120% capacity and run 5-minute canary at 01:15 (10% traffic).

infra-bot: Canary status: PASS. p95 +5ms, errors 0. OK to proceed.

oncall: Observed a small spike in TLS handshake delays on edge-proxy for ~70s during scale. Pausing full cutover to investigate.

omar: Looking at proxy metrics: handshakes queued due to file-descriptor exhaustion on proxy-host-3. Temp fix: increase ulimit and restart proxy on host-3. Applying now.

infrastructure-bot: Restart completed. Post-restart handshakes normalized.

nora: Resuming cutover. KV warmup verified.

violet: Full cutover complete by 01:35. Post-checks green. Keeping SLO leniency annotation for 20m cooldown.

omar: Postmortem (brief): root cause = fd limit too low on proxy host under bursty reconnects during scale. Action items: add ulimit check to preflight (omar), add fd monitoring alert (nora), and include fd-tune in proxy bootstrap (infra).

oncall: Closing drill. Runbook updated with notes. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
